candidates.label: Misdeeds removed and condition amended for believers in Muhammad's revelation
candidates.definition: In 47:2: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muhammad, and it is the truth from their Lord, He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ وَءَامَنُواْ بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّهِمۡ كَفَّرَ عَنۡهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمۡ وَأَصۡلَحَ بَالَهُمۡ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Combat instructions with favour-or-ransom until war ends
candidates.definition: In 47:4: So when you meet those who disbelieve in battle strike their necks until when you have inflicted slaughter upon them then secure their bonds and either confer favour afterwards or ransom them until the war lays down its burdens.

evidence.excerpt: فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَضَرۡبَ ٱلرِّقَابِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَثۡخَنتُمُوهُمۡ فَشُدُّواْ ٱلۡوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنَّۢا بَعۡدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتَّىٰ تَضَعَ ٱلۡحَرۡبُ أَوۡزَارَهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَلَوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَٱنتَصَرَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَبۡلُوَاْ بَعۡضَكُم بِبَعۡضٖۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ قُتِلُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Divine testing through mutual conflict as alternative to direct vengeance
candidates.definition: In 47:4: And if Allah had willed He could have taken vengeance upon them Himself but He ordered armed struggle to test some of you by means of others; and those killed in the cause of Allah, never will He waste their deeds.

evidence.excerpt: فَإِذَا لَقِيتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فَضَرۡبَ ٱلرِّقَابِ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَثۡخَنتُمُوهُمۡ فَشُدُّواْ ٱلۡوَثَاقَ فَإِمَّا مَنَّۢا بَعۡدُ وَإِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتَّىٰ تَضَعَ ٱلۡحَرۡبُ أَوۡزَارَهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَلَوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ لَٱنتَصَرَ مِنۡهُمۡ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَبۡلُوَاْ بَعۡضَكُم بِبَعۡضٖۗ وَٱلَّذِينَ قُتِلُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Believers supporting Allah receiving support and firm footing
candidates.definition: In 47:7: O you who have believed, if you support Allah He will support you and plant firmly your feet.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِن تَنصُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ يَنصُرۡكُمۡ وَيُثَبِّتۡ أَقۡدَامَكُمۡ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Travel showing destroyed predecessors with comparable fate for disbelievers
candidates.definition: In 47:10: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allah destroyed everything over them and for the disbelievers is something comparable.

evidence.excerpt: ۞أَفَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡۖ دَمَّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمۡۖ وَلِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ أَمۡثَٰلُهَا
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Paradise with four unchanging rivers against intestine-severing Fire
candidates.definition: In 47:15: Is the description of Paradise which the righteous are promised wherein are rivers of water unaltered, milk unchanged, wine delicious and purified honey with all fruits and forgiveness from their Lord, like those abiding eternally in Fire given scalding water severing intestines?

evidence.excerpt: مَّثَلُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِي وُعِدَ ٱلۡمُتَّقُونَۖ فِيهَآ أَنۡهَٰرٞ مِّن مَّآءٍ غَيۡرِ ءَاسِنٖ وَأَنۡهَٰرٞ مِّن لَّبَنٖ لَّمۡ يَتَغَيَّرۡ طَعۡمُهُۥ وَأَنۡهَٰرٞ مِّنۡ خَمۡرٖ لَّذَّةٖ لِّلشَّـٰرِبِينَ وَأَنۡهَٰرٞ مِّنۡ عَسَلٖ مُّصَفّٗىۖ وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ وَمَغۡفِرَةٞ مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ كَمَنۡ هُوَ خَٰلِدٞ فِي ٱلنَّارِ وَسُقُواْ مَآءً حَمِيمٗا فَقَطَّعَ أَمۡعَآءَهُمۡ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Sealed hearts following desires exposed through post-departure questioning
candidates.definition: In 47:16: And among them are those who listen to you until when they depart from you they say to those given knowledge what has he said just now; those are the ones Allah has sealed over their hearts and who follow their desires.

evidence.excerpt: وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَسۡتَمِعُ إِلَيۡكَ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا خَرَجُواْ مِنۡ عِندِكَ قَالُواْ لِلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ مَاذَا قَالَ ءَانِفًاۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ طَبَعَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Guidance increased and righteousness granted to the guided
candidates.definition: In 47:17: And those who are guided, He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱهۡتَدَوۡاْ زَادَهُمۡ هُدٗى وَءَاتَىٰهُمۡ تَقۡوَىٰهُمۡ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Tawheed knowledge and istighfar commanded under divine awareness
candidates.definition: In 47:19: So know O Muhammad that there is no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin and for believing men and women; and Allah knows of your movement and resting place.

evidence.excerpt: فَٱعۡلَمۡ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعۡلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمۡ وَمَثۡوَىٰكُمۡ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Hypocrites death-stricken at fighting mention despite requesting a surah
candidates.definition: In 47:20-21: Those who believe say why has a surah not been sent down; but when a precise surah is revealed and fighting is mentioned therein you see those in whose hearts is hypocrisy looking at you with a look of one overcome by death; more appropriate for them would have been obedience and good words.

evidence.excerpt: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَتۡ سُورَةٞۖ فَإِذَآ أُنزِلَتۡ سُورَةٞ مُّحۡكَمَةٞ وَذُكِرَ فِيهَا ٱلۡقِتَالُ رَأَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَيۡكَ نَظَرَ ٱلۡمَغۡشِيِّ عَلَيۡهِ مِنَ ٱلۡمَوۡتِۖ فَأَوۡلَىٰ لَهُمۡ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: طَاعَةٞ وَقَوۡلٞ مَّعۡرُوفٞۚ فَإِذَا عَزَمَ ٱلۡأَمۡرُ فَلَوۡ صَدَقُواْ ٱللَّهَ لَكَانَ خَيۡرٗا لَّهُمۡ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Turning away producing corruption and severed kinship earning divine curse
candidates.definition: In 47:22-23: So would you perhaps if you turned away cause corruption on earth and sever your ties of relationship; those are the ones Allah has cursed so He deafened them and blinded their vision.

evidence.excerpt: فَهَلۡ عَسَيۡتُمۡ إِن تَوَلَّيۡتُمۡ أَن تُفۡسِدُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوٓاْ أَرۡحَامَكُمۡ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

evidence.excerpt: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمۡ وَأَعۡمَىٰٓ أَبۡصَٰرَهُمۡ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Heart-locks preventing Quran reflection
candidates.definition: In 47:24: Then do they not reflect upon the Quran or are there locks upon their hearts?

evidence.excerpt: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ أَمۡ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقۡفَالُهَآ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Satan enticing reverters with prolonged hope after clarity
candidates.definition: In 47:25: Indeed those who reverted back after guidance had become clear to them, Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱرۡتَدُّواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَدۡبَٰرِهِم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلۡهُدَى ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمۡ وَأَمۡلَىٰ لَهُمۡ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Obedience to Allah and Messenger commanded without deed invalidation
candidates.definition: In 47:33: O you who have believed obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds.

evidence.excerpt: ۞يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَلَا تُبۡطِلُوٓاْ أَعۡمَٰلَكُمۡ
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.

candidates.label: Withholding spending as self-harm against Allah's freedom from need
candidates.definition: In 47:38: Here you are invited to spend in the cause of Allah but among you are those who withhold out of greed; whoever withholds only withholds from himself; Allah is Free of need while you are needy; if you turn away He will replace you with another people unlike you.

evidence.excerpt: هَـٰٓأَنتُمۡ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ تُدۡعَوۡنَ لِتُنفِقُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَمِنكُم مَّن يَبۡخَلُۖ وَمَن يَبۡخَلۡ فَإِنَّمَا يَبۡخَلُ عَن نَّفۡسِهِۦۚ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلۡفُقَرَآءُۚ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوۡاْ يَسۡتَبۡدِلۡ قَوۡمًا غَيۡرَكُمۡ ثُمَّ لَا يَكُونُوٓاْ أَمۡثَٰلَكُم
evidence.rationale: Full verse text as evidence for the cited span.
